title: Habitat Charter / 栖居地章程
author: Civenthra contributors
text: A fictional habitat council records each shared-resource decision, the evidence considered, the dissenting view, and the date for review. 这个虚构栖居地议事会记录每项公共资源决定、采用的证据、反对意见以及复核日期。

title: Learning Log / 学习日志
author: Civenthra contributors
text: 每条课程结论都附上本地证据编号、内容版本和复核状态。A learner can follow the local evidence identifier, content version, and review status behind every lesson claim.
